project_name: Dr. D — Queue-Based Smart Clinic Platform
theme: Light mode primary with rich Deep Navy (#172554 & #1E3A8A) structural anchors and Emerald Mint (#059669 & #34D399) kinetic alerts
archetype: ORGANIC & CLINICAL PRECISION (Trust, Calm & High-Velocity Queue Flow)

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

component_strategies.header: Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/80 sticky top-0 z-50
component_strategies.patient_live_ticket: Hero gradient surface with animated pulse border, live ETA countdown timer, token badge, position indicator, and status badge
component_strategies.doctor_consult_view: Split screen view: Left panel for active patient & Dai AI summary brief, Right panel for queue list, past notes, and quick action controls
component_strategies.staff_reception_board: High-density queue dispatcher, single-click 'Send Next Patient', walk-in modal, skip/delay controls, and live delay notifier (+15m)
component_strategies.dai_ai_chat: Floating bottom-right trigger FAB (#34D399 glow), expandable drawer/dialog with streaming typing effect, suggested queries, and clinic info bot
component_strategies.toast_notifications: Sonner toast system for live alert sound/flash ('15 min remaining' and 'You are next!'), plus HTML5 browser notification permission prompt

clinic_hero.description: Modern quiet waiting lounge - Dr. D Clinic Network

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion: Page fade-in, queue card slide-up, ticket number ticker counter, active patient pulse badge
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons include subtle scale lift (hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98]) and shadow transition

testing_and_accessibility.mandatory_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use transparent header or dropdown backgrounds. Ensure proper backdrop-blur and solid fallback colors.
Maintain contrast standards (4.5:1 min for text). Use APCA contrast guide.
Always set explicit hover text colors when hover background changes.
Leverage Sonner for live queue toasts and browser Notification API for 'You are next!' alerts.
